The relevant data includes internal emails, Microsoft Teams chat records, calendars, spreadsheets, booking and frequent flyer records, as well as marketing, productivity, operations, and human resources data. Spirit stated that the data delivered to Google will be anonymized to remove personally identifiable information. This transaction also faces competition, as AI data company Mercor previously offered $7.5 million for the related data. The deal still requires approval from the U.S. bankruptcy court, with U.S. Bankruptcy Judge Sean Lane expected to review the transaction on Wednesday local time. Spirit Airlines ceased operations in May of this year and is selling its remaining assets through bankruptcy proceedings. The relevant data includes internal emails, Microsoft Teams chat records, calendars, spreadsheets, booking and frequent flyer records, as well as marketing, productivity, operations, and human resources data. Spirit stated that the data delivered to Google will be anonymized to remove personally identifiable information. This transaction also faces competition, as AI data company Mercor previously offered $7.5 million for the related data. Spirit Airlines ceased operations in May of this year and is selling its remaining assets through bankruptcy proceedings.
